messages.subject: How to destroy all apps
parts:
It has been confirmed in another thread that it is not possible to remove an app, so the only possibility seems to destroy the whole account.

Our company has enforced strong restrictions on putting anything into the cloud. Ask your that guy with asylum in Moscow why. Thanks,  NSA, for listening.

Please advise how to make sure that the slate is clean.

Dieter Menne
